intended_meaning: Terminal-Bench measures multi-step CLI task completion by an agent, distinct from code generation alone.
layout_and_reading_order: One robot agent at a generic terminal follows a left-to-right task chain: instruction, command action, file/result check, next-step decision, and completion/scoring. The authored entry memo explicitly takes precedence over the source's four dashboard cards and specifies a single robot character.
source_vs_brief_conflict: Current image uses four dense dashboard cards and two human figures plus one robot; the authored figure memo specifies one robot at a terminal and a linear task chain. Memo provides explicit layout and character-count precedence; two humans are listed under REMOVE.
character_policy: Preserve one existing pet robot as the agent; remove two source human figures per the authored single-robot figure memo; add or redesign no characters.
